title: Collector fact contract (evidence input side)
description: The one shape every evidence adapter yields, on any platform, before a fact may reach fact_to_evidence. A fact is telemetry: it records WHAT was checked, WHERE, WHEN and what the source reported. It is never a compliance determination and never carries a status the package layer would treat as a verdict. The package layer learns nothing about the platform from this shape. Loaded and enforced by automation/collectors/evidence_wiring.py (validate_fact, EvidenceAdapter.to_evidence); the AWS collectors predate this contract and are bound to it by the collector fixture tests rather than at conversion time.

service.description: Source slug the check belongs to (an evidence source registered in the source registry, e.g. a scanner or a cloud service). Becomes a segment of the evidence object key, so it must be slug-safe.

check.description: Identifier of the individual check or rule within the source. Becomes a segment of the evidence object key, so it must be slug-safe.

status.description: The source's own observation string for this check (e.g. a count, a percentage, COMPLIANT, ENABLED). Free text, scrubbed and bounded before it enters the package. Not a compliance verdict. A value starting with ERROR records a failed read and is not evidence.

detail.description: Short human summary of the observation. May be empty. Scrubbed (identifiers, secrets, hosts, addresses redacted) and bounded before it enters the package.

region.description: Where the observation was made (a region slug or 'global'). Becomes a segment of the evidence object key, so it must be slug-safe.

observed_at.description: When the SOURCE observed this (ISO 8601 date or date-time, the first ten characters a calendar date). Never invented by an adapter: carry the source's real timestamp so evidence freshness is honest.

scope.description: OPTIONAL opaque scope identifier (an HMAC-derived scope-... id or a caller-supplied slug alias) that distinguishes one account, tenant, subscription, compartment, project or host of a deployment from another WITHOUT naming it. Never a raw identifier.

run_id.description: OPTIONAL slug-safe identifier of the collection run that produced the fact.

x-rawScopeRule: A fact carrying any x-rawScopeFields value and no `scope` is exported ONLY when the caller supplies a deployment-private scope_key, from which an opaque scope id is derived; otherwise the fact is REFUSED with an explicit error naming the field. The raw value never enters an evidence object, a pointer or a hash input.

rawScopeIdentifier.description: A raw platform identifier of the scope an observation came from (a cloud account, tenant, subscription, compartment, project or organization, or the host name of an on-premises scan target). Legitimate on an INPUT fact; it must be replaced by an opaque scope before export (see x-rawScopeRule).
